event.text: Call 911 now and go to an emergency department; do not drive yourself. Black tarry stools usually mean bleeding in the upper digestive tract, and feeling lightheaded when you stand can mean you have lost enough blood to affect your circulation — this needs urgent in-person assessment. While waiting, stay lying down and tell the dispatcher if your symptoms worsen. If someone is with you, ask them to update the dispatcher if you faint, become confused or cannot speak for yourself.
